prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a cat version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: A cute cartoon meme reaction image of a chubby, round, blob-shaped bright yellow cat laughing hysterically, rendered in a simple, smooth, slightly plasticky 3D CGI style like a low-budget children's TV mascot. The cat's head and body merge into one plump egg-like shape that is wider at the bottom, colored egg-yolk yellow with a paler cream oval patch on its belly, with two small pointed triangular cat ears on top of the head, tiny stubby rounded arms and legs with no visible fingers, a short curled yellow tail, and three thin whiskers on each cheek. Its front-facing face fills most of the body: both eyes are squeezed shut with laughter, drawn as two thick black upward-curving arcs (upside-down U shapes) set wide apart, and its mouth is an enormous frog-like wide-open grin stretching almost the full width of the face, shaped like a big rounded U, showing a dark pink mouth interior, a small flat row of white upper teeth, and a little pink tongue. Add two large soft pink blush ovals on the cheeks, a tiny pink triangular nose, and a few small teardrops flying from the outer corners of the eyes to show it is laughing so hard it is crying. The head is tilted slightly back, one stubby paw presses against its round belly, and the other paw is raised as if pointing and mocking the viewer. Smooth glossy shading, soft even studio lighting, exaggerated and comical expression, centered composition, plain pure white background, sticker/emoji style, no text, no watermark, high resolution.
